description: Measured on this tree: a newline after `=` does not continue the assignment. 1 statement; `ol-bad-token` at parse stage for the end-of-line after `=`. Recovery discards the assignment; the surviving node is a bare NumberLit `3` (not an Assign) — measured but not mechanically asserted, because the harness format supports only events and diagnostics, and a parse error suppresses instruction events. See #1077.
